settings.heading: Build a routine, save one fifth.
settings.text: Choose a cleanser, a cream, an SPF and a serum. The set price updates as you tick them.
settings.saving_text: Four or more items takes 20% off the set.

settings.heading: Choose your steps
settings.text: Wash, treat, moisturize and protect: pick one product for each.

settings.heading: Watch the price drop
settings.text: The discount appears as soon as your set reaches four items.

settings.heading: Get it as a gift
settings.text: Every set ships in a pink pouch with an optional note.

settings.heading: Be first to know about the next drop
settings.message: New scents, balm flavours and member-only sale days, no more than one note a week.
